{
  "taskId": "HC-007",
  "attempt": 1,
  "status": "READY_FOR_REVIEW",
  "summary": "Read-only audit complete using supplied excerpts only. Lead disposition: INCOMPLETE, not already verified. PASS for several source-level spotlight and inventory contracts; UNVERIFIED for current visual behavior and authoritative NPC equipment validation; REWORK for replacement-dialog state initialization. No files changed or tests executed.",
  "changedFiles": [],
  "tests": [],
  "screenshots": [],
  "evidence": [
    "PASS — source structure: App/MASTER_SPEC.md and App/UI_UX_SPEC.md require four expanded Journey sections with sequential focus. src/features/healthclues/WorldAdventureScene.tsx renders focus, checklist, herbs and practices together, assigns exactly one is-tour-active class and three is-tour-muted classes, and inserts dialogue immediately before the active section.",
    "PASS — source scrolling/accessibility: src/features/healthclues/WorldAdventureScene.tsx scrolls the modal body to reveal dialogue and target, observes container/target/dialogue resizing, respects reduced-motion scrolling, focuses the active section and traps Tab during the Journey tutorial. Actual styling, stacking and background interaction blocking remain unverified.",
    "PASS — Pet renderer: src/features/healthclues/HealthCluesPet.tsx contains region-specific Luna owl and Lumi firefly SVG rendering. App/reports/PET_TOOLKIT_KNOWLEDGE_ACCEPTANCE.md describes an older missing-Pet state that is superseded for this narrow source finding; the supplied renderer does not establish a shared Pet Engine.",
    "PASS — source inventory semantics: src/features/healthclues/WellnessWorldGame.tsx creates a World with an empty selections array. src/features/healthclues/WorldAdventureScene.tsx derives Journey equipment from equipped entries, filters Botanist herbs by nutrition origin and botanical metadata, and supports legacy practice entries without a discovery station. Plan statuses are displayed separately from completion.",
    "PASS — collection boundary in supplied route: src/app/api/healthclues/world/collection/route.ts authenticates requests, scopes writes to auth.id, checks active/current/reviewed Catalog status and restricts detected TEST ONLY content outside the owner demo. Saving writes Collection only; deletion rejects items referenced by Toolkit history. Authentication-helper behavior and database enforcement were not supplied.",
    "REWORK — replacement initialization: src/features/healthclues/ToolkitCollection.tsx initializes equipmentPosition to 1 and replaceEntryId to an empty string. Opening Request Equip/Replace only changes equipId; the occupant ID is populated only when the position select changes. Confirming the default occupied position therefore omits replaceEntryId, and a later dialog can retain stale replacement state. Server rejection versus mutation outcome is unknown.",
    "UNVERIFIED — authoritative NPC equipment rules: App/BUSINESS_RULES.md and App/ACCEPTANCE_TESTS.md require NPC proximity, reviewed eligibility and account-scoped equipment validation. src/features/healthclues/ToolkitCollection.tsx sends equipment requests without station/proximity context. The equipment handler, station component, map interaction implementation and database validator definitions were not supplied, so their enforcement cannot be established or declared absent.",
    "UNVERIFIED — existing tests: scripts/run-healthclues-game-e2e.mjs contains equipment lifecycle, Collection separation, history and isolation assertions, but uses synthetic Catalog rows, locally minted credentials and mocked Auth/OTP responses with local database/REST services. It expects retired onboarding and four equipped entries in one case. scripts/test-healthclues-world-db.mjs exercises synthetic SQL fixtures and legacy equip RPCs; neither supplied script establishes current NPC-origin or spotlight acceptance. No execution evidence was supplied.",
    "UNVERIFIED — reported acceptance: App/reports/HEALTHCLUES_WORLD_EXPERIENCE_ACCEPTANCE.md reports older local NPC/equipment/browser passes. App/reports/HEALTHCLUES_MASTER_PROMPT_17_ACCEPTANCE.md reports newer Botanist empty-state acceptance and explicitly leaves eligible botanical Save/Equip unaccepted. These are report claims, not independently inspected screenshots or execution artifacts.",
    "OPEN CONFLICT — initial sequencing: App/UI_UX_SPEC.md places recommendations after the existing Pet welcome. In src/features/healthclues/WorldAdventureScene.tsx, initialPlanPrompt opens Journey once guideReady is true and hides the guide without checking that welcome finished. src/features/healthclues/WellnessWorldGame.tsx enables that prompt for adaptive activation. Runtime ordering needs verification and reconciliation with the approved requirement.",
    "REPORT CHRONOLOGY — App/CURRENT_STATE.md is owner-authored progress evidence only. App/reports/HEALTHCLUES_MASTER_PROMPT_17_ACCEPTANCE.md includes later bilingual/legacy follow-up claims that supersede some earlier negative checkpoints, but none closes current spotlight or eligible botanical equipment acceptance. App/reports/HEALTHCLUES_MASTER_PROMPT_16_ACCEPTANCE.md provider/build claims likewise do not verify HC-007."
  ],
  "knownLimitations": [
    "Only supplied content was reviewed; manifest hashes were not independently recomputed.",
    "No screenshot pixels, current execution logs, spotlight styles, guide persistence handler or equipment validation implementation were supplied.",
    "Current desktop/mobile visual behavior, EN/VI dialogue completeness, NPC proximity enforcement, replacement persistence and tutorial persistence are unknown.",
    "No live provider or production integration was verified. Synthetic fixture and reported local acceptance remain scoped evidence."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "Current visual acceptance cannot be established without inspectable screenshots and associated build/run evidence.",
    "Authoritative equipment acceptance cannot be established from the supplied client and collection/world routes alone.",
    "Eligible botanical Save/Equip coverage remains blocked by unavailable reviewed eligible content according to App/reports/HEALTHCLUES_MASTER_PROMPT_17_ACCEPTANCE.md; current catalog availability was not independently verified."
  ],
  "nextSuggestedSteps": [
    "Fix Collection equipment-dialog initialization so opening an item derives replacement state from the selected position and current entries; verify occupied default position, switching items, cancellation and stale occupant rejection.",
    "Reconcile initialPlanPrompt sequencing with the approved Pet-welcome order, then verify first activation and returning-player guide behavior.",
    "Supply current equipment validation source and focused execution artifacts covering NPC proximity/origin, eligibility, owner isolation, explicit replacement, history and reload.",
    "Capture and inspect current desktop/mobile Journey tour evidence for all four stops, long sections, viewport changes, background blocking and EN/VI presentation. Keep botanical success pending reviewed eligible content."
  ]
}
